add.k: A cruel hitman who does Fisk's killing
st: Rance kills Daniel Fisher and frames Karen, then attacks her for the flash drive until a masked man beats him; he dies in his cell.

files.notes: On screen only in Into the Ring (S1E1); named there by Wesley and Fisk. Found hanged in his cell the same night (DD103 confirms the cell death). Fisk's Empire is the app's name for Fisk's organization, which hires him for several jobs.

add.k: A New York senator in Wilson Fisk's pocket
st: Cherryh praises Fisk's gala speech, clears his zoning for an extra cut, and is arrested still insisting Fisk did nothing wrong.

files.notes: On screen in S1E10 (gala) and S1E13 (FBI arrest, press statement); named as Senator Cherryh in dialogue from S1E9. The first name Randolph is only on a newspaper prop per the wiki, so the file uses Senator Cherryh. No group is named for him on screen (the Senate is never named as such), so Independent; he is a bribed ally of Fisk, not a member. Opposing hero set to Daredevil by default, as Fisk's exposure in S1 is Matt's campaign; they never meet.

add.k: A Kitchen Irish gunman hunting the Punisher
st: Rory leads Cooley's hunt for the Punisher, drugs him in Central Park, then, shot and bleeding, gives Daredevil the answers he wants.

files.notes: Penny and Dime (S2E4) only; Cooley says 'It's Rory, isn't it?'. Status In custody follows the wiki: police units arrive as Daredevil finishes with him.

k: A fight fixer who backs Jack Murdock's bouts
The fixer who had Jack Murdock killed
st: Sweeney gets Jack Murdock a match with Creel on condition he goes down in the fifth round, and Jack is killed for winning.
Elektra ambushes Sweeney at his home, and Matt beats him for killing Jack, then calls the police on the fugitive.

files.notes: Jack calls him Roscoe and Silke calls him Mr. Sweeney in Cut Man (S1E2, past events); present day in Kinbaku (S2E5), where he boasts he killed Jack. No crew name is ever said, so Independent. Daredevil: Born Again S2E4 (Gloves Off) reuses the Cut Man footage of him with Jack; left out as archive footage, matching Jack Murdock's own file, which has no Born Again step.

add.k: Roscoe Sweeney's partner in fixing fights
st: Silke and Sweeney bring Jack Murdock a match with Creel and press him until he agrees to go down in the fifth round.

files.notes: Jack greets him as 'Silke' in Cut Man (S1E2); 'Sammy' comes only from the showrunner, so the file uses Silke. No crew name is said, so Independent. He never faces Matt, so the opposing figure is Jack Murdock, the boxer he leans on. Born Again S2E4 reuses the Cut Man footage; left out as archive footage, matching Jack Murdock's file.

st: Santino finds a wounded masked man in a dumpster, gives Claire up to the Russians under torture, then hands him the Veles Taxi lead.

files.notes: Claire names him in Cut Man (S1E2); he names himself to Matt in In the Blood (S1E4). No group, so Independent.

add.k: A Ranskahov enforcer who does the Russians' dirty work
st: Sergei tortures Santino and Claire over the masked man, readies the Russians for war on Fisk, and is shot dead by a crooked cop.

files.notes: Named by Vladimir in In the Blood (S1E4); killed by Officer Corbin in Condemned (S1E6), right after World on Fire (S1E5) ends with the police arriving. The app's Russian Mafia group, which the Ranskahovs run.

add.k: A programmer forced to run Fisk's hotel surveillance
st: Forced to run Fisk's hotel cameras, Shelby tells Daredevil that Fisk wants Karen dead and later shuts down the elevators for him.

files.notes: Fisk calls her Mrs. Shelby in Aftermath (S3E7). Forced service counts, so Fisk's Empire; she turns on him by helping Daredevil (S3E10, S3E13), hence Independent after, staged in the same season as the app does for Felix Manning.

st: Shirley gives Ben Urich's wife more days in a private room, runs Metro-General through the bombings, then tells Ben the appeal failed.
Shirley stands by Claire after the Hand strikes Metro-General, but goes along with the cover-up, and Claire quits.
Shirley welcomes Claire back to Metro-General and moves the wounded man she brings in to the head of the queue.

files.notes: Called Shirley in dialogue (S1E3, S2E11, IF S1E6). The surname Benson is from an ID badge per the wiki, episode unverified, so the file uses Shirley. Jessica Jones S1E13 only mentions her (no step). The wounded man in Iron Fist is Radovan, not named by her.

add.k: Roxxon's money man, under the Hand's thumb
st: Blackmailed by the Hand, Roxxon's Stan Gibson leads Daredevil to his captive son at the Farm and is killed by the boy.

files.notes: Introduced by name in Kinbaku (S2E5) as the money man for Roxxon's Japanese arm; Roxxon Corporation is said repeatedly. 'Roxxon' is the app's existing spelling for that company (Cloak & Dagger files). He dies at the end of The Man in the Box (S2E10); .380 (S2E11) confirms his son killed him. Victim of the Hand, so a hero file.

add.k: A jailed mortgage analyst who becomes Fisk's man at Rikers
st: Stewart warns Fisk about Dutton, takes his money, and hands Frank Castle a shiv and the seven-minute plan to reach Dutton.

files.notes: Fisk names him ('his name is Stewart Finney') in Seven Minutes in Heaven (S2E9). Fisk pays him and he works for Fisk inside Rikers, so Fisk's Empire. Frank is the hero Fisk's plan uses and then betrays; Matt never meets him.

add.k: A contractor's thug harassing Elena Cardenas' building
st: A thug jumps Karen in an alley over Elena's building and threatens her with her own pepper spray, until she sprays him instead.

files.notes: On screen in Stick (S1E7), credited only as 'Tribal Tattoo'. Karen names him (Stewart Schmidt and Joseph Pike) in Speak of the Devil (S1E9), identified from contractor's licenses, which show Westmeyer-Holt Contracting as employer of record (company named in S1E8 and S1E9). He never faces Matt, so Karen is the opposing hero.

add.k: An NYPD precinct captain who runs the C-4 task force
st: The captain runs the task force on the hidden C-4, threatens to jail Jessica, Luke and Matt, and watches Midland Circle fall.
Captain Strieber locks down Clinton Church after the killings there and hands the scene to Nadeem's FBI team.

files.notes: In The Defenders (E2, E7, E8) he is only called 'Captain'; the name Strieber appears there only as subtitle speaker tags. He introduces himself as Captain Strieber, 15th Precinct, in Reunion (DD S3E11), so the name is staged there. Luke Cage S2 and Jessica Jones S3 only mention him (no steps).

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Rance drugs Karen and her coworker Daniel Fisher, kills Fisher and leaves Karen to take the blame. Later he breaks into her apartment and beats her for the flash drive until a masked man stops him.
stages.whoA: The secretary he tries to kill for her flash drive
stages.whoB: Fisk's hitman who attacked her at home

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: A masked man breaks up Rance's attack on Karen, and the two crash through a window into the rainy street. The masked man beats him, chains him up and leaves him for the press with Karen's drive.
stages.whoA: The masked man who beat him in the rain
stages.whoB: Fisk's hitman he beat to save Karen

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wesley shows Rance on a live feed outside Officer Farnum's daughter's school to force Farnum's hand. When Rance is caught, Wesley pins Fisher's murder on him.
stages.whoA: Fisk's right hand, who gives him his jobs
stages.whoB: The hitman he sends after Fisk's targets

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Senator Cherryh's office asks Fisk for a meeting, and at Fisk's gala Cherryh praises his speech and pulls him aside about the zoning for his Hell's Kitchen plans. He clears the last hurdles for an extra 10 percent, then tells the press after his arrest that neither of them did anything wrong.
stages.whoA: The businessman whose zoning he clears for a cut
stages.whoB: The senator who clears his zoning for a price

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Cooley remembers Rory at the wake for the Kitchen Irish dead and sends him after the shooter who took his money. Rory leads the hunt to the Punisher's apartment and springs the trap in Central Park.
stages.whoA: The Kitchen Irish boss who sends him after the Punisher
stages.whoB: Kitchen Irish gunman who leads his hunt for the Punisher

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Rory corners the Punisher at the Central Park carousel and jabs him with a sedative as the shooting starts. Rory is hit in the gut in the crossfire as Frank goes down.
stages.whoA: The shooter he hunts for Cooley
stages.whoB: Kitchen Irish gunman who drugged him in Central Park

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Daredevil finds the wounded Rory crawling from the carousel and disarms him. Twisting his arm while he bleeds, Daredevil makes him say the Punisher did the killing and where Cooley took him.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who made him talk
stages.whoB: Kitchen Irish gunman he forced to talk

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Sweeney and Silke offer Jack a fight with Creel, on the condition that he goes down in the fifth round. Jack agrees, then wins by knockout instead and is killed.
stages.whoA: The boxer he paid to throw the Creel fight
stages.whoB: The fixer who wanted him to throw the fight

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Elektra ties Sweeney to a chair in his own home for Matt. Sweeney taunts Matt about killing his father, and Matt beats him senseless but refuses to kill him and calls the police.
stages.whoA: Battlin' Jack's son, who beat him and turned him in
stages.whoB: The fixer who had his father killed

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Elektra ambushes Sweeney at his front door, pins his throat under her heel and ties him up for Matt. She urges Matt to cut his throat, then slips away when he calls the police.
stages.whoA: The woman who ambushed him for Matt
stages.whoB: Jack Murdock's killer, her gift to Matt

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Sweeney and Silke set up the Creel fight together, with Silke saying Mr. Sweeney can be persuasive. They press Jack side by side until he says he will go down in the fifth.
stages.whoA: His partner in fixing Jack's fight
stages.whoB: The fixer he works beside

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Silke brings Jack news of a match with Creel and tells him the money would do a lot of good for his boy. Jack agrees to go down in the fifth round, then wins anyway.
stages.whoA: The boxer he leans on to take a dive
stages.whoB: Sweeney's partner who pushed him to take a dive

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Santino, Claire's upstairs neighbor, finds a wounded masked man in the dumpster and fetches Claire to help. Later Russians torture him until he tells them where Claire is hiding.
stages.whoA: His neighbor, the nurse
stages.whoB: Her young upstairs neighbor

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Santino finds the masked man in the alley and sees his face. After Claire is taken, the masked man finds him hurt and frightened, tells him it is not his fault, and gets the Veles Taxi lead from him.
stages.whoA: The masked man he found in the dumpster
stages.whoB: Claire's neighbor who found him in the dumpster

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Sergei and another Russian catch Santino watching them at Claire's door and take him to the roof. They torture him until he gives up where Claire is, and threaten his mother.
stages.whoA: Claire's neighbor he tortured for her location
stages.whoB: The Russian who tortured him on the roof

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Sergei snatches Claire, takes her to the Veles Taxi garage and beats her for the masked man's name, nearly killing her with a bat. When the masked man breaks Sergei's hand, Claire knocks him out with his own bat.
stages.whoA: The nurse he tortured for the masked man
stages.whoB: The Russian who tortured her at Veles Taxi

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: The masked man cuts the lights at the Veles garage, breaks Sergei's hand and frees Claire. After Fisk's bombs, he beats Sergei and Vladimir in the street until crooked cops arrive and one shoots Sergei dead.
stages.whoA: The masked man who broke his hand
stages.whoB: Russian thug who tortured Claire

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Sergei tells Vladimir it was the masked man who hit the garage. After Anatoly's death Vladimir orders him to ready every soldier for war on Fisk, and Sergei carries him out of the bombed building before both are caught.
stages.whoA: The Russian boss he serves
stages.whoB: His loyal enforcer

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk keeps Shelby at the Presidential Hotel running his cameras and has her bring him the news. She turns on him, telling Daredevil his plans and shutting down the elevators during his wedding.
stages.whoA: The boss who forced her to run his cameras
stages.whoB: The programmer he forced to run his surveillance

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Daredevil finds Shelby alone in Fisk's control room, and she tells him Fisk wants Karen killed and warns he will never get another chance at Fisk. He comes back on Fisk's wedding day and asks her to shut down the elevators, and she does.
stages.whoA: The vigilante she helps against Fisk
stages.whoB: Fisk's surveillance programmer who helps him

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Felix has Shelby tap into the cameras at the Nadeem home. She watches with him as the Fisks decide Nadeem has become too dangerous.
stages.whoA: Fisk's fixer who gives her orders
stages.whoB: Fisk's surveillance programmer

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Shirley runs Metro-General through the flood of bombing victims and finds Claire, who called in sick, treating patients. She tells her she is glad to have her back.
stages.whoA: Her best nurse
stages.whoB: Metro-General's administrator

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: After the Hand's killers murder Louisa, Shirley tells Claire the hospital is calling it a junkie's attack. Claire calls it hush money, Shirley says she needs her job, and Claire quits.
stages.whoA: The nurse who quits over the cover-up
stages.whoB: The administrator who goes along with the cover-up

stages.title: Iron Fist S1
stages.text: Claire walks back into Metro-General with a wounded man, and Shirley has him put at the head of the queue. Claire thanks her.
stages.whoA: Her former nurse, back with a patient
stages.whoB: Her old boss at Metro-General

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Ben brings Shirley his wife Doris's appeal and her favorite blintzes, and she gives Doris five more days in a private room. Later she has to tell him the extension was turned down.
stages.whoA: The reporter whose wife she tries to help
stages.whoB: The administrator handling Doris's care

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt spills wine on Stan at a party, and Stan is knocked out while the ledger is stolen. Later Daredevil corners him, learns the Hand took his son Daniel, and Stan leads him to the Farm to free the boy.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who helps him find his son
stages.whoB: Roxxon's money man whose son the Hand took

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Claire treats Stan's son Daniel at Metro-General after the rescue from the Farm. Stan thanks her and asks how he can repay her.
stages.whoA: The nurse who treats his son
stages.whoB: The father of a Farm victim she treats

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Stewart warns the new inmate Fisk about Dutton's hold on Rikers, and Fisk has his lawyer bolster Stewart's legal retainer. Stewart then helps Fisk plan Dutton's death around Frank Castle.
stages.whoA: The inmate who buys his loyalty
stages.whoB: A fellow inmate who becomes his man

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Stewart stands by as Fisk makes his offer to Frank in the yard. He lays out the seven-minute window to reach Dutton and hands Frank a shiv.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he arms to kill Dutton
stages.whoB: Fisk's inmate who handed him the shiv

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: A thug drags Karen into an alley and demands to know why she is bothering Elena, threatening to empty her own pepper spray into her eyes. She kicks him down and sprays him once Foggy steps in.
stages.whoA: The woman he jumped over Elena's building
stages.whoB: The thug who jumped her outside Elena's

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Foggy follows Karen and breaks up the thug's alley attack by clubbing his partner with a baseball bat. The thug is left in the alley as they get away.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who broke up his attack on Karen
stages.whoB: One of the thugs who jumped Karen

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: The captain briefs Misty at the C-4 scene and runs the task force she works on. He warns her the case can make or break her, sends her after the escaped vigilantes, and at Midland Circle tells her she had better still have a job.
stages.whoA: The detective on his task force
stages.whoB: Her task force captain

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Strieber is commanding the Clinton Church scene when Nadeem arrives and names Daredevil as the FBI's suspect. Strieber briefs him on the lockdown and hands over command.
stages.whoA: The FBI agent who takes over his scene
stages.whoB: The NYPD captain at Clinton Church

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: The captain holds Luke, Jessica and Matt after they are found with a body and threatens to jail them unless they talk. Luke tells him about the Hand and Danny, and the captain says vigilantes have no jurisdiction.
stages.whoA: The vigilante he interrogates about the Hand
stages.whoB: The captain who threatened to jail him

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: The captain questions Jessica after she turns up with Luke and Matt beside a body, and calls her one of two super powered people he will lock in a room. She escapes the precinct with the others.
stages.whoA: The private eye he holds for questioning
stages.whoB: The captain who interrogated her

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Matt plays lawyer for Jessica and Luke in the captain's interrogation and reminds him that super powered people still have legal rights. The captain threatens to book him for obstruction, and the three slip out of the precinct.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who stonewalled his interrogation
stages.whoB: The captain who threatened to book him

dropped.why: Only ever called 'Warden' in Please, The Devil You Know and Aftermath (DD S3); the name Riggle is never said in the transcripts and nothing shown is cited, so it is a credits-only name.
Named in Please and No Good Deed, but he has no lines: in Resurrection he is only beaten and groaning, then lies in a coma. Fails the 'lines' rule.
The Rikers guard is never named in Guilty as Sin or Seven Minutes in Heaven (Finney calls him only 'one guard'); credits-only name.
Ben Urich never calls him by name in Rabbit in a Snowstorm, and he is not named at the funeral in Daredevil; credits-only name.
Stick never says his name in The Dark at the End of the Tunnel; 'Star' appears only as subtitle speaker tags and in the credits.

changes.why: Officer Corbin shoots Sergei at the start of Condemned (S1E6); World on Fire ends with the cops only arriving.

changes.was: Named by Vladimir in In the Blood (S1E4); killed by Officer Corbin in World on Fire (S1E5). The app's Russian Mafia group, which the Ranskahovs run.

changes.why: Death is in S1E6, not S1E5.
The text ends with a crooked cop shooting Sergei, which happens in S1E6.
The stage's last events (zoning cleared for an extra cut, arrest and press statement) are in S1E13.

changes.why: The step ends in S1E7, but his name is first said by Karen in S1E9, so the name cannot appear yet.

changes.now: Shirley gives Ben Urich's wife more days in a private room, runs Metro-General through the bombings, then tells Ben the appeal failed.
changes.why: She tried to get the extension and only brings Ben the news that it failed; she does not deny it herself.
